2025-06-02.riddle: I keep you dry, I keep you warm, I wrap you up in comfort form. I lie on beds or couch with you— What am I?
2025-06-02.hint: I’m soft, cozy, and make naps better.

2025-06-03.riddle: I glow at night but I’m not the moon, I chase away the dark too soon. I rest on desks or by your bed— What am I?
2025-06-03.hint: I shine only when you want me to.

2025-06-04.riddle: I hold the floor but I’m not glued, You wipe your shoes, that’s what I do. I’m found inside, just by the door— What am I?
2025-06-04.hint: Step on me, I don’t mind.

2025-06-05.riddle: I take you up, I bring you down, I move with ease without a sound. You’ll see me inside every floor— What am I?
2025-06-05.hint: I lift without legs and open with doors.

2025-06-06.riddle: I come in sticks, I come in wax, I draw on walls or paper packs. With colors bright, I’m used in school— What am I?
2025-06-06.hint: I color your world, one stroke at a time.

2025-06-07.riddle: I flash in storms, I crack the sky, I strike the ground but never cry. I come with thunder, loud and bright— What am I?
2025-06-07.hint: I’m a spark from the sky.

2025-06-08.riddle: I flash in red, I guard the street, I help the cars and people meet. With green and yellow, too, I show— What am I?
2025-06-08.hint: I decide when you can move.

2025-06-09.riddle: I fill with air but cannot breathe, You play with me, then I may leave. I float around and pop with glee— What am I?
2025-06-09.hint: I rise at parties but don’t last long.
